notes: Eval contract for the /diagram diagramming-knowledge-kit (Design 15), generating to the Design-14 house grammar (Grammar-version 14.1.0). Stages 1-3 (parse+resolve -> validate -> lower-to-IR) are pure/deterministic; the five resolver error codes are a closed kebab-case enum. The negative fixtures assert the EXACT code, never a paraphrase. specId IS the spec id; the correlation token lives in a sentinel shape id `__specid__<specId>`.

evals.prompt: Run stages 1-3 (parse+resolve -> validate -> lower-to-IR) on the build-first pipeline->cohort-cycle composite spec (workstream-pipeline drilldown ref xreview-cohort) twice, with the grammar pinned at house@14.1.0, no clock/RNG/MCP. Compare the two emitted canonical IR artifacts.
expected_behavior: Loads diagram-house-profile.md (pins house@14.1.0) + the kit-linear-pipeline and kit-circular-cohort templates before lowering (Guardrail: profile- and kit-first)
Stages 1-3 perform NO side effects: no Lucid MCP call, no clock read, no RNG; layout is a pure function of (template + node count/order + grammar constants), stable-ordered by node id
Emits a canonical IR (sorted-key JSON, no timestamps/RNG) whose two field-groups are distinct: semantic/structural vs house-style/layout
The two runs produce BYTE-IDENTICAL IR (the reproducibility guarantee keyed by specHash + Grammar-version); diffs to the committed golden IR
Does NOT render in this eval (render is stage 4, side-effecting); determinism is asserted on the IR artifact, not the PNG
evals.source: method.md stage 3 (lower); Design 15 AC golden-IR keyed by (specHash + Grammar-version); stages 1-3 pure/deterministic

evals.prompt: Validate the pipeline->cohort-cycle composite: workstream-pipeline (token linear-pipeline, ordered stages left->right, one stage carrying drilldown {ref: xreview-cohort, rel: expands-to}) and xreview-cohort (token circular-cohort, central work-artifact + >=3 ring nodes incl one role:dissenter). Both pin schemaVersion + style: house@14.1.0.
expected_behavior: Runs the two-tier gate BEFORE any render: (a) JSON-Schema validity against the schemaVersion-pinned spec schema, discriminated over the 7 token values; (b) the full house rule set resolved from the Design-14 grammar at the pinned version via diagram-house-profile.md (one token per role, legend lists exactly the roles present, plain title, ASCII labels)

Resolver passes: drilldown.ref resolves; child token circular-cohort is in the linear-pipeline.stage allow-list { circular-cohort }; the graph is acyclic; depth within the fixed bound of 3; both instances pin the same Grammar-version (composite is grammar-homogeneous)
Concludes it conforms; cites the profile rule / grammar version per check, not a naked 'looks fine'
Does not manufacture findings; defers the actual Lucid render to stage 4 (the LucidAdapter) only after the gate passes
evals.source: Design 15 AC two-tier conformance gate; method.md stage 2; the build-first composite

evals.prompt: A spec's drilldown carries {ref: cohort-typo, rel: expands-to} but no instance with id cohort-typo exists in the composite set.
expected_behavior: Stage 1 parse+resolve fails resolving the ref
Rejects with the EXACT error code `unresolved-ref` (closed kebab-case enum)
Does NOT render; the gate runs before render
evals.source: Design 15: resolver rejects an unresolved ref (unresolved-ref)

evals.prompt: A linear-pipeline stage carries drilldown to a child whose token is hub-and-spoke. The MVP slot allow-list is linear-pipeline.stage -> { circular-cohort } only.
expected_behavior: Resolver checks the child token against the slot allow-list declared per slot-role in the kit-<token>.md
hub-and-spoke is not in { circular-cohort }, so it rejects with the EXACT error code `token-not-allowed`
Does NOT render
evals.source: Design 15: child token not in slot allow-list (token-not-allowed); MVP value linear-pipeline.stage -> { circular-cohort }

evals.prompt: Instance A drills down to B, and B drills down back to A (a drilldown cycle).
expected_behavior: Stage 1 runs the visited-set cycle check (NOT the no-back-pointer convention) and finds A reachable from itself
Rejects with the EXACT error code `cycle-detected`
Does NOT render
evals.source: Design 15: any cycle (cycle-detected; visited-set check, not the no-back-pointer convention)

evals.prompt: A drilldown chain root -> L2 -> L3 -> L4 (the root is depth 1; this reaches depth 4, strictly greater than the fixed bound of 3).
expected_behavior: Stage 1 enforces the fixed depth bound of 3 with root=depth-1; depth 4 is strictly > 3
Rejects with the EXACT error code `depth-exceeded`
Does NOT treat depth 3 as the violation (the bound is satisfied at depth 3; the fire is at depth >= 4)
evals.source: Design 15: depth exceeding the fixed bound of 3 (depth-exceeded; root is depth 1, fires at depth >= 4)

evals.prompt: A composite where workstream-pipeline pins style: house@14.1.0 and its drilldown-reachable child xreview-cohort pins style: house@14.0.0.
expected_behavior: Stage 1 grammar-homogeneity check finds the drilldown-reachable instance set does not all pin one Grammar-version
Rejects with the EXACT error code `grammar-version-mismatch` (the error-code literal, distinct from the Grammar-version field name)
Does NOT render a mixed-version composite
evals.source: Design 15: composite with mixed grammar pins (grammar-version-mismatch); all drilldown-reachable instances share one Grammar-version

evals.prompt: A composite's committed manifest records are inspected: workstream-pipeline's record carries renderedGrammarVersion 14.1.0 and xreview-cohort's record carries renderedGrammarVersion 14.0.0 (a mid-render or partial re-render left the member records on mixed grammar versions).
expected_behavior: Reads staleness from the committed manifest with NO Lucid round-trip (the records carry renderedGrammarVersion + renderedSchemaVersion + specHash)
Flags the composite as INCONSISTENT (requires re-render): member records carry mixed renderedGrammarVersion within one composite

States the all-or-nothing render invariant: a composite re-render stages all N doc reconciles, then commits all N manifest records last, so no committed manifest state ever mixes Grammar-versions within one composite
Distinguishes this render-layer mixed-stamp inconsistency from the validate-layer grammar-version-mismatch (the spec-pin homogeneity check) — different layers, both fail-closed
Does NOT silently render over the strand; treats a mid-render failure's repairable strands as specId-matched (sentinel shape id __specid__<specId>), human-confirmed at the cohort gate
evals.source: Design 15: staleness oracle flags mixed renderedGrammarVersion composites inconsistent; composite re-render all-or-nothing; manifest record {specId, lucidDocId, renderedGrammarVersion, renderedSchemaVersion, specHash}
